items.content_excerpt: $ADUR The Infrastructure Behind Growth: $SPCX $NBIS Some of the most important technology stories in the market today are usually described as software stories, AI stories or space stories. But behind all of them sits something much less abstract: physical infrastructure. SpaceX (NASDAQ: SPCX) may be associated with rockets, satellites and global communications, but those businesses depend on an enormous network of launch systems, ground infrastructure, manufacturing capacity, energy and materials. Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) is building for a different market entirely, yet its AI cloud ambitions ultimately depend on the same physical realities. Compute capacity has to be housed somewhere, powered continuously, cooled efficiently and connected through increasingly dense networks of hardware. That is what makes Aduro Clean Technologies (NASDAQ: ADUR) relevant to the same broader conversation. Aduro is not building rockets or data centers, and it has no commercial relationship with SpaceX or Nebius. Its role in this comparison is more fundamental. The company is developing technology aimed at improving the usefulness of difficult hydrocarbon feedstocks and recovering value from plastic waste that is harder to recycle conventionally. SpaceX, Nebius and Aduro operate in very different industries, but all three sit inside the same physical economy. Growth still requires energy. It still requires materials. And increasingly, it requires better ways to use the resources already available.: https://www.secfilings.com/news/the-infrastructure-behind-growth-spcx-nbis-and-adur
